snippet.title: Toxic Crusaders Official Trailer | #TheIndiePremier
snippet.description:
The Toxic Crusaders return in an all-new beat 'em up adventure for up to four players. Grab your mop, your tutu, and your attitude as you clean up the mean streets of Tromaville one radioactive menace at a time.

Developed and published by Retroware.
